_readme: Load-bearing claims of the money skill, for scripts/verify_claims.py. Each claim is verified when a fetched page contains any of its quotes (expect=present) or none of them (expect=absent). Quotes are short strings copied from the research snippets or the number as it is written on the page; numbers are tried in both Icelandic and English formats. Run from a machine with open internet; the sandbox that built this file could reach none of these hosts.
